inbox.name: Inbox
inbox.description: Cards proposed from outside the app (browser extension, links, local API, clipboard) wait here for your review.

deep_links.name: Links
deep_links.description: Opens flashcard:// links from other programs. Links that add cards only propose them to the inbox.

clipboard.name: Clipboard suggestions
clipboard.description: Off by default. When on, the app looks at text you copy and offers to add it as a card. Nothing is stored unless you accept; text that looks like a password, key or card number is ignored, and so is content your system marks as private.

quick_add.name: Quick add
quick_add.description: A global shortcut opens a small window to add a card while the app is in the background.

local_api.name: Local API
local_api.description: Lets programs on this computer (such as the browser extension) talk to the app. Only this computer can connect, and each program needs your approval.

min_chars.label: Shortest suggestion (characters)
min_chars.description: Copied text shorter than this is ignored.

max_chars.label: Longest suggestion (characters)
max_chars.description: Copied text longer than this is ignored.

shortcut.label: Quick add shortcut
shortcut.description: For example CommandOrControl+Alt+N. Takes effect after a restart.

prefill_clipboard.label: Fill in copied text
prefill_clipboard.description: When the quick add window opens, put the copied text on the front.

port.label: Port
port.description: The app listens on 127.0.0.1 at this port only. Takes effect when the module is switched on again.

inbox_max_items.label: Waiting proposals per program
inbox_max_items.description: Most card proposals one program may have waiting in the inbox. More are refused until you handle some.

inbox_max_kib.label: Waiting size per program (KiB)
inbox_max_kib.description: Most text one program may have waiting in the inbox, in kibibytes.

inbox_daily_max.label: Proposals per program per day
inbox_daily_max.description: Most cards one program may propose in 24 hours, whatever happened to them. Keeps a program (or a rule that accepts its proposals) from flooding the collection.

inbox.add: Propose a card to the inbox

validation.api_client: This connection request is not valid.

conflict.rate_limited: Too many requests; try again shortly.
conflict.api_client_state: This program's request was already handled or has expired.

permission.origin_not_allowed: Requests from this origin are not allowed.

inbox.empty_rejected_hint: Proposals you reject are listed here.
inbox.empty_hint: Cards proposed by the browser extension or other programs wait here for you.

local_api.heading: Local API
local_api.intro: Programs on this computer can propose cards and read your decks through the local API. Only this computer can connect, at 127.0.0.1:{port}. Each program asks once; you decide what it may do.

pairing.title: Connection request
pairing.hint: Only allow programs you installed yourself. You can revoke this any time under Local API.

local_api.none_allowed: No program has been allowed yet.
